name: chat
description: A feedback chat: a plain question answered with no notes; a selection review by another editor that leaves a comment and a word-choice suggestion, then replies; the selection mapped through a later edit; a question about a note whose session fails; a second chat that fails before starting; words retyped from a reply.

payload.body:
Harbour works. It names the place the chapter never leaves.

If you want more pull, let the harbour wait for morning.
The empty door is the real event; give it a beat.

suggestion.rationale: A rarer word slows the eye.

payload.body: Two notes on the opening: the door matters more than the rain, and one word could slow the reader down.

content.text: Night. The rain fell sideways over the harbour. Nobody came to the door. Mara counted the boats twice. Let the harbour wait for morning.
